faq.q: How do I install Hungry Shark Evolution on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Hungry Shark Evolution and check the developer is Ubisoft Entertainment before tapping Install. It needs Android 6.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Ubisoft Entertainment and may be altered, so the safest way to play Hungry Shark Evolution is the official listing.

faq.q: How do I unlock new sharks in Hungry Shark Evolution?
faq.a: Level your current shark by eating and surviving, then buy the next shark with coins. Some special sharks need gems or come from events.
Eating gold creatures fills a meter. When it's full, Gold Rush makes your shark invincible for a short time and boosts points.

faq.q: Does Hungry Shark Evolution work offline?
faq.a: Yes, the main game works offline. Events, daily rewards and ads need a connection.
